Subject: Request: consolidated MSA triage + onboarding checkpoint

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Novus is excited to move into contract and onboarding. Legal ran a quick pass and attached a consolidated redline (Novus_MSA_v3_redlines.pdf). Before we hand this to procurement, legal asked for a short triage call to:

- Confirm a handful of terms (data retention, audit logs)
- Verify the onboarding evidence list and owners
- Lock a demo follow-up for the integrations team

We have two legal folks on the thread — Priya and I. Our availability windows (PST):
- Tue 22 Jun: 9–11am or 3–5pm
- Wed 23 Jun: 11am–1pm

If those don't work for your legal or sales ops folks, we can offer a "tile trade" — Novus can move one of our internal reviewers to a later slot in exchange for an earlier hands-on onboarding window with your implementation lead.

Attached: Novus_MSA_v3_redlines.pdf (annotated), evidence checklist (draft).

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Head of Procurement, Novus Health

- Hannah (legal) will triage contract language.
- Ben (in procurement ops) would like to join for the scheduling handoff — I'll loop him if we lock a time.

Of your windows, Wed 23 Jun 11:00–12:00 PST works best for Hannah and Marissa. If you need the earlier tile (Tue morning), suggest "tile trade": we can swap the integration demo to Tue 3pm if Novus can shift one legal reviewer to Wed afternoon.

Proposed agenda (45 mins):
1) 0–10m: quick context + goals for triage
2) 10–35m: redline walk (Hannah leads)
